def radial_graph_energy(
    positions: Array,
    cell: Array,
    radial_centers: Array,
    radial_coefficients: Array,
    cutoff: float,
) -> Array:
    """Evaluate a minimal periodic radial-graph energy for one atomic species."""

    displacement = positions[:, None, :] - positions[None, :, :]
    fractional = displacement @ jnp.linalg.inv(cell)
    fractional -= jnp.round(fractional)
    displacement = fractional @ cell

    off_diagonal = ~jnp.eye(positions.shape[0], dtype=bool)
    squared_distance = jnp.sum(displacement**2, axis=-1)
    distance = jnp.sqrt(jnp.where(off_diagonal, squared_distance, 1.0))
    active_edge = off_diagonal & (distance < cutoff)

    radial_width = radial_centers[1] - radial_centers[0]
    radial_features = jnp.exp(
        -0.5 * ((distance[..., None] - radial_centers) / radial_width) ** 2
    )
    cutoff_envelope = 0.5 * (jnp.cos(jnp.pi * distance / cutoff) + 1.0)
    edge_energy = (radial_features @ radial_coefficients) * cutoff_envelope
    return 0.5 * jnp.sum(jnp.where(active_edge, edge_energy, 0.0))


atoms = bulk("Al", "fcc", a=4.05, cubic=True) * (2, 2, 2)
positions = jnp.asarray(atoms.positions).at[0, 0].add(0.08)
cell = jnp.asarray(atoms.cell.array)
radial_centers = jnp.linspace(2.0, 3.5, 10)
learned_coefficients = -jnp.array(
    [0.12, 0.04, -0.06, -0.12, -0.08, -0.01, 0.03, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0]
)
energy_fn = partial(
    radial_graph_energy,
    cell=cell,
    radial_centers=radial_centers,
    radial_coefficients=learned_coefficients,
    cutoff=3.6,
)
energy, gradient = jax.value_and_grad(energy_fn)(positions)
forces = -gradient
initial = ParticleState(
    positions, jnp.zeros_like(positions), jnp.full((32,), 26.9815)
)
next_state = velocity_verlet_step(energy_fn, initial, time_step=0.5)

print(f"graph nodes / directed edges=32 / 384")
print(f"learned graph energy={float(energy):.6f} eV")
print(f"force on displaced atom={forces[0].round(6).tolist()} eV/angstrom")
print(f"net force={jnp.sum(forces, axis=0).round(7).tolist()} eV/angstrom")
print(
    f"atom-0 displacement after one teaching Verlet step="
    f"{float(next_state.positions[0, 0] - positions[0, 0]):.7f} angstrom"
)
